name: web-apps
title: Web Apps
description: Create and manage website apps with browser profiles, custom icons, optional PWA installation and borderless WebKit windows.
author: alhimowicz

commands.name: create-web-app
commands.title: Create Web App
commands.description: Add a website to Vicinae and GNOME with its own window and icon

commands.name: web-apps
commands.title: Web Apps
commands.description: Open, edit or remove your web app launchers

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test

preferences.name: browserExecutable
preferences.title: Custom Browser Executable
preferences.description: Optional native Chromium-based browser executable. Set its user-data directory too. Leave both empty for automatic browser discovery.

preferences.name: browserDataDirectory
preferences.title: Custom Browser User-data Directory
preferences.description: Directory containing Local State and your browser profiles, such as ~/.config/chromium. Required with a custom executable.

preferences.name: pythonPath
preferences.title: Python 3 Interpreter
preferences.description: Optional Python interpreter with PyGObject. Automatically detected from PATH when empty. Used for icons, PWA detection and optional GTK/WebKit windows.
